title: Dubai
description: Experience futuristic luxury in Dubai — soaring skyscrapers like the Burj Khalifa, gold and spice souks, exhilarating desert safaris, Palm Jumeirah, and world-class theme parks.
highlights: Burj Khalifa 124th & 125th Floor Observation Deck
Desert Safari with Dune Bashing, Camel Ride & BBQ Dinner
Dubai Marina Luxury Dhow Cruise with Dinner
Palm Jumeirah & Atlantis The Palm Monorail
Miracle Garden & Global Village Multi-Cultural Fair
Abu Dhabi Day Trip to Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque

itinerary.title: Arrival in Dubai & Marina Dhow Cruise
itinerary.description: Arrive at Dubai International Airport. VIP airport pickup and transfer to your hotel. Evening luxury Dhow Cruise along Dubai Marina with dinner and live entertainment.

itinerary.title: Dubai City Tour & Burj Khalifa
itinerary.description: Explore Dubai Creek, Al Fahidi Historical District, Gold & Spice Souks. Afternoon visit to Dubai Mall and Burj Khalifa 124th/125th floor observation deck, followed by Dubai Fountain show.

itinerary.title: Desert Safari with Dune Bashing & BBQ
itinerary.description: Morning at leisure. Afternoon 4x4 Desert Safari with thrilling red dune bashing, camel riding, sandboarding, falcon photography, and a lavish BBQ buffet dinner under starry skies with Tanoura & belly dance shows.

itinerary.title: Palm Jumeirah, Atlantis & Monorail
itinerary.description: Scenic drive to Palm Jumeirah, ride the Palm Monorail, photo stop at Atlantis The Palm, visit The View at The Palm, and unwind at JBR The Walk and Marina Beach.

itinerary.title: Miracle Garden & Global Village
itinerary.description: Visit the world's largest natural flower garden at Dubai Miracle Garden with 150 million blooming flowers. Evening at Global Village showcasing pavilions, shows, and culinary delights from 90+ countries.

itinerary.title: Abu Dhabi Day Trip & Sheikh Zayed Mosque
itinerary.description: Full-day excursion to Abu Dhabi. Marvel at the breathtaking Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque, drive along the Corniche, visit Emirates Palace and Ferrari World photo stop before returning to Dubai.

itinerary.title: Souk Shopping & Airport Departure
itinerary.description: Leisurely breakfast, last-minute shopping at Mall of the Emirates or Meena Bazaar. Timely private transfer to Dubai International Airport for your return flight.

title: Thailand & Bangkok
description: Discover the best of Thailand — Bangkok's ornate Buddhist temples, vibrant floating markets, chaotic night bazaars, combined with tropical paradise beaches, limestone cliffs, and island hopping.
highlights: Grand Palace & Temple of the Reclining Buddha (Wat Pho)
Chao Phraya Princess Luxury Dinner Cruise
Coral Island Speedboat Tour with Parasailing & Snorkeling
Phi Phi Islands & Maya Bay Speedboat Excursion
James Bond Island & Phang Nga Bay Sea Canoe
Damnoen Saduak Floating Market & Safari World

itinerary.title: Arrival in Bangkok & Transfer to Pattaya
itinerary.description: Arrive at Suvarnabhumi Airport, meet our concierge and private transfer to Pattaya. Hotel check-in, evening Alcazar Cabaret Show and Pattaya Beach Road walk.

itinerary.title: Coral Island (Koh Larn) Speedboat Adventure
itinerary.description: Speedboat cruise to Coral Island. Enjoy pristine white sand beaches, swimming, parasailing, undersea walking, and an authentic Thai seafood lunch buffet.

itinerary.title: Pattaya to Bangkok & Chao Phraya Dinner Cruise
itinerary.description: Drive back to Bangkok. Visit Gems Gallery and transfer to hotel. Evening Chao Phraya River luxury dinner cruise with illuminated views of Wat Arun and the Grand Palace.

itinerary.title: Bangkok Temples & Safari World
itinerary.description: Visit Wat Pho (Reclining Buddha), Wat Traimit (Golden Buddha), and the Grand Palace. Afternoon at Safari World & Marine Park with dolphin and stunt shows.

itinerary.title: Fly Bangkok to Phuket & Patong Beach
itinerary.description: Morning flight to Phuket. Check-in to tropical beach resort. Evening explore Bangla Road, Patong Night Market, and sunset viewpoints.

itinerary.title: Phi Phi Islands & Maya Bay Tour
itinerary.description: Full-day speedboat excursion to Phi Phi Don, Phi Phi Leh, Maya Bay (The Beach movie fame), Viking Cave, Monkey Beach, and snorkeling in crystal-clear turquoise waters.

itinerary.title: James Bond Island & Sea Canoeing
itinerary.description: Speedboat trip across Phang Nga Bay. Explore James Bond Island (Koh Tapu), limestone caves, mangrove forests, and paddle sea canoes through Koh Panak sea caverns.

itinerary.title: Phuket Old Town & Airport Departure
itinerary.description: Morning visit to Phuket Old Town Sino-Portuguese heritage street and Big Buddha. Afternoon transfer to Phuket International Airport for flight home.

title: Bali
description: Immerse yourself in tropical paradise with Bali's emerald rice terraces, cliff-hanging ancient sea temples, sacred monkey forests, volcanic lakes, and pristine Nusa Penida island beaches.
highlights: Uluwatu Sunset Temple perched on 70m ocean cliff with Kecak Dance
Nusa Penida Island Tour: Kelingking T-Rex Beach & Angel's Billabong
Tegallalang Rice Terraces & Famous Bali Jungle Swing
Kintamani Volcano & Batur Lake Viewpoint
Ulun Danu Beratan Floating Temple on Lake Bratan
Water Sports Package at Tanjung Benoa (Banana Boat, Jet Ski)

itinerary.title: Denpasar Arrival & Private Villa Check-in
itinerary.description: Arrive at Ngurah Rai International Airport (DPS). Traditional flower garland welcome, private transfer to luxury villa in Ubud, evening sunset relaxation.

itinerary.title: Ubud Culture, Rice Terraces & Bali Swing
itinerary.description: Visit Sacred Monkey Forest Sanctuary, explore Tegallalang Emerald Rice Terraces, ride the iconic Bali Jungle Swing, and stroll through Ubud Royal Palace & Art Market.

itinerary.title: Kintamani Volcano, Coffee Plantation & Tegenungan
itinerary.description: Scenic drive to Kintamani with panoramic views of active volcano Mount Batur and Lake Batur. Visit authentic Luwak coffee plantation and Tegenungan Waterfall.

itinerary.title: Nusa Penida Island Day Tour by Speedboat
itinerary.description: Speedboat cruise to Nusa Penida Island. Explore the world-famous Kelingking T-Rex Cliff Beach, Broken Beach, Angel's Billabong natural infinity pool, and Crystal Bay.

itinerary.title: Ulun Danu Beratan & Handara Iconic Gate
itinerary.description: Journey to the Bedugul highlands. Visit the enchanting Ulun Danu Beratan Temple floating on Lake Bratan, snap photos at Handara Iconic Balinese Gate, and visit Tanah Lot Temple at sunset.

itinerary.title: Tanjung Benoa Water Sports & Uluwatu Cliff
itinerary.description: Head to South Bali. Enjoy thrilling water sports at Tanjung Benoa (Parasailing, Jet Ski, Banana Boat). Afternoon drive to clifftop Uluwatu Temple for spectacular Indian Ocean sunset and Kecak Fire Dance.

itinerary.title: Seminyak Beach Club & Traditional Balinese Spa
itinerary.description: Morning at leisure on Seminyak beach. Indulge in a 2-hour authentic Balinese herbal aromatherapy body massage & flower bath. Sunset at a world-class beach club.

itinerary.title: Krisna Souvenir Bazaar & Airport Departure
itinerary.description: Breakfast at villa, shopping for Balinese handicrafts, batik, and souvenirs at Krisna Oleh-Oleh. Private transfer to Denpasar Airport for flight home.

title: Exclusive Europe
description: The ultimate European grand voyage spanning the romantic streets of Paris, snow-covered summits of the Swiss Alps, timeless Venetian canals, and the historic Roman Empire.
highlights: Eiffel Tower Summit with Seine River Romantic Cruise
Louvre Museum Priority Access with Mona Lisa Viewing
Jungfraujoch — Top of Europe at 3,454m & Ice Palace
Mount Titlis World's First Rotating Rotair Cable Car
Venice Sunset Gondola Ride through Grand Canal
Rome Colosseum, Roman Forum & Vatican St. Peter's Basilica

itinerary.title: Arrival in Paris — The City of Lights
itinerary.description: Arrive at Paris Charles de Gaulle Airport. Meet your European tour concierge and transfer to your hotel. Evening romantic Seine River cruise showcasing illuminated bridges and landmarks.

itinerary.title: Paris City Highlights & Eiffel Tower Summit
itinerary.description: Comprehensive city tour: Champs-Élysées, Arc de Triomphe, Place de la Concorde, Opera Garnier, and Notre-Dame photo stop. Ascend to the Eiffel Tower summit followed by Louvre Museum exterior.

itinerary.title: Paris to Switzerland via TGV High-Speed Train
itinerary.description: Board the ultra-fast TGV train through picturesque French countryside into Switzerland. Arrive in Interlaken/Lucerne nestled between alpine lakes and snow-capped peaks.

itinerary.title: Mount Titlis with Ice Flyer & Lucerne
itinerary.description: Ascend Mount Titlis on the world's first revolving Rotair cable car. Experience the Cliff Walk suspension bridge, Glacier Cave, and Ice Flyer. Afternoon Lucerne Chapel Bridge and Lion Monument walk.

itinerary.title: Jungfraujoch — Top of Europe Excursion
itinerary.description: Cogwheel train journey up to Jungfraujoch (3,454 meters). Tour the magical Ice Palace, Sphinx Observatory with panoramic views of Aletsch Glacier, and Alpine Sensation.

itinerary.title: Switzerland to Venice (Italy)
itinerary.description: Scenic coach drive through the Swiss Alps and Italian Lake District into Venice. Arrive in the floating city, check-in to hotel, evening at leisure.

itinerary.title: Venice Gondola Ride & St. Mark's Square
itinerary.description: Private motorboat transfer to St. Mark's Square. Guided tour of St. Mark's Basilica, Doge's Palace, Bridge of Sighs, Murano Glass demonstration, and a quintessential Venetian Gondola ride.

itinerary.title: Venice to Florence & Rome
itinerary.description: Drive to Florence — the cradle of the Renaissance. Walking tour of Florence Cathedral (Duomo), Ponte Vecchio, Piazza della Signoria. Continue drive to Rome.

itinerary.title: Rome City Tour, Colosseum & Trevi Fountain
itinerary.description: Full-day tour of Rome: Exterior of Colosseum, Roman Forum, Victor Emmanuel Monument, toss a coin into the Trevi Fountain, Pantheon, and Piazza Navona. Farewell European banquet dinner.

itinerary.title: Vatican City & Departure from Rome
itinerary.description: Visit Vatican City — St. Peter's Square and Basilica. Last-minute Italian shopping before private transfer to Rome Fiumicino Airport for your departure flight.

title: Phuket & Krabi
description: Explore the stunning Andaman coastline — towering limestone karsts, crystal-clear emerald pools, iconic Railay Beach, Hong Islands, and the world-famous Phi Phi archipelago.
highlights: Phi Phi Don & Phi Phi Leh Speedboat Tour with Maya Bay
Krabi 4-Island Speedboat Tour (Poda, Chicken, Tup & Phra Nang Cave)
Hong Islands Marine Park Lagoon with Sea Kayaking
Emerald Pool (Sa Morakot) & Natural Hot Springs Waterfall
James Bond Island Sea Canoe in Phang Nga Bay
Tiger Cave Temple (Wat Tham Suea) Summit Panorama

itinerary.title: Arrival in Phuket & Patong Beach Check-in
itinerary.description: Arrive at Phuket International Airport. Transfer to beachfront resort in Patong. Evening free to relax on the beach, explore night markets and seaside cafes.

itinerary.title: Phi Phi Islands & Maya Bay Speedboat Tour
itinerary.description: Full-day speedboat island hopping tour: Maya Bay, Pileh Lagoon swimming, Viking Cave, Monkey Beach, snorkeling among colorful coral reefs, and buffet lunch on Phi Phi Don.

itinerary.title: James Bond Island & Phang Nga Bay Canoeing
itinerary.description: Cruise into Phang Nga Bay National Park. Marvel at the dramatic James Bond Island needle rock, paddle canoes through hidden limestone caves, and visit Panyee floating Muslim village.

itinerary.title: Phuket to Krabi via Scenic Coastal Drive
itinerary.description: Check-out and scenic overland transfer to Krabi (Ao Nang). En route stop at Wat Suwan Kuha (Monkey Cave Temple). Check-in to Krabi tropical resort.

itinerary.title: Krabi 4-Island Speedboat Tour & Railay Beach
itinerary.description: Speedboat tour of Krabi's famous 4 Islands: Koh Poda, Chicken Island snorkeling, Tup Island sandbar walk at low tide, and Phra Nang Cave Beach with princess shrine at Railay.

itinerary.title: Emerald Pool, Hot Springs & Tiger Cave Temple
itinerary.description: Jungle excursion to the mineral-rich crystal Emerald Pool, relax in natural cascading geothermal hot spring waterfalls, and climb to the Tiger Cave Temple panoramic viewpoint.

itinerary.title: Hong Islands Lagoon & Sunset Beach Dinner
itinerary.description: Speedboat cruise to Hong Island. Explore the emerald enclosed lagoon, snorkel at Pelay Beach, relax on powdery sand, and enjoy a romantic farewell sunset dinner in Ao Nang.

itinerary.title: Krabi Souvenirs & Airport Departure
itinerary.description: Morning breakfast, leisure swim at resort pool, last-minute shopping at Ao Nang walking street, and transfer to Krabi / Phuket Airport for flight back.

title: Sri Lanka
description: The pearl of the Indian Ocean — ancient UNESCO rock fortresses, scenic hill country blue trains, misty Ceylon tea plantations, wild elephant safaris, and golden sandy beaches.
highlights: Sigiriya Lion Rock Fortress 5th Century UNESCO Citadel Climb
Kandy Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic & Cultural Dance
Scenic Blue Train Ride through Misty Nuwara Eliya Tea Valleys
Yala National Park 4x4 Leopard & Elephant Safari
Bentota Madu River Mangrove Boat Safari & Turtle Hatchery
Galle Dutch Fort 17th Century UNESCO Heritage Walk

itinerary.title: Colombo Arrival & Transfer to Sigiriya
itinerary.description: Arrive at Bandaranaike International Airport (CMB). Meet our guide and transfer to Sigiriya. En route visit Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage to watch herds bathe in the river.

itinerary.title: Sigiriya Lion Rock Fortress & Dambulla Cave Temple
itinerary.description: Morning climb of the ancient Sigiriya Lion Rock citadel with ancient frescoes and water gardens. Afternoon visit the Golden Dambulla Rock Cave Temple complex containing 150+ Buddha statues.

itinerary.title: Matale Spice Garden & Kandy Sacred Tooth Temple
itinerary.description: Drive to Kandy. Visit an aromatic Matale spice garden and Royal Botanical Gardens Peradeniya. Evening visit the sacred Temple of the Tooth Relic and watch a traditional Kandyan cultural fire-dance show.

itinerary.title: Scenic Train to Nuwara Eliya & Tea Factory
itinerary.description: Board the legendary Sri Lankan blue train through misty highlands, waterfalls, and tea gardens to Nuwara Eliya ("Little England"). Visit a functioning Ceylon tea factory and Gregory Lake.

itinerary.title: Ella Nine Arch Bridge & Yala National Park
itinerary.description: Drive past Ravana Falls to Ella. Photo stop at the iconic Nine Arch Bridge. Continue down to Yala. Afternoon 4x4 open jeep safari in Yala National Park for leopards, elephants, and sloth bears.

itinerary.title: Yala to Bentota Coastal Beach Resort
itinerary.description: Drive along the southern coastline to the tropical beaches of Bentota. En route visit the historic 17th-century UNESCO Galle Dutch Fort with lighthouse and boutique streets.

itinerary.title: Madu River Mangrove Boat Safari & Turtle Hatchery
itinerary.description: Scenic motorboat safari on the Madu River through mangrove tunnels with fish therapy stops. Visit Kosgoda Sea Turtle Conservation Project to release baby turtles into the ocean.

itinerary.title: Colombo City Tour & Airport Departure
itinerary.description: Drive to Colombo. Panoramic city tour: Gangaramaya Temple, Independence Memorial Hall, Galle Face Green, and shopping at Odel / Pettah Market. Transfer to airport for departure.

title: Lakshadweep
description: India's pristine tropical archipelago in the Arabian Sea — shallow turquoise lagoons, vibrant living coral atolls, coconut groves, and tranquil island tranquility untouched by crowds.
highlights: Scenic Flight Landing on Narrow Agatti Island Coral Airstrip
Speedboat Day Excursion to Uninhabited Bangaram Island
Thinnakara Island Coral Reef Snorkeling with Sea Turtles
Glass-Bottom Boat Lagoon Cruise with Live Coral Viewing
Kayaking & Stand-Up Paddleboarding in Crystal Turquoise Lagoon
Kalpitti Island Sunset Boat Cruise

itinerary.title: Flight Arrival at Agatti Island Lagoon
itinerary.description: Fly into Agatti Airport with breathtaking aerial views of coral reefs. Warm coconut water welcome and transfer to beach resort. Afternoon lagoon walk and relaxation.

itinerary.title: Agatti Water Sports & Glass Bottom Boat
itinerary.description: Morning glass-bottom boat ride over shallow lagoons to view live coral gardens, clownfish, and sea anemones. Afternoon kayaking, swimming, and sunset at Agatti South Beach.

itinerary.title: Speedboat Excursion to Bangaram & Thinnakara
itinerary.description: Full-day excursion by speedboat across turquoise waters to uninhabited Bangaram Island and Thinnakara Island. Snorkel with sea turtles, relax on deserted sandbanks, and enjoy beach picnic lunch.

itinerary.title: Coral Reef Snorkeling & Kalpitti Island Cruise
itinerary.description: Morning guided deep-reef snorkeling session. Afternoon boat trip to Kalpitti Island for panoramic views, beachcombing, and farewell seaside candlelight dinner.

itinerary.title: Island Souvenirs & Flight Departure
itinerary.description: Morning breakfast overlooking the turquoise lagoon. Local handicraft souvenir shopping, transfer to Agatti Airport for your return flight.

title: Singapore & Malaysia
description: The twin jewel combination of Southeast Asia — futuristic architecture at Marina Bay, Gardens by the Bay, Universal Studios Sentosa, paired with Kuala Lumpur's iconic Petronas Towers and Genting Highlands.
highlights: Gardens by the Bay Flower Dome, Cloud Forest & Supertree Light Show
Sentosa Island & Universal Studios Full Day Theme Park Pass
Night Safari Tram Ride with Nocturnal Wildlife
Petronas Twin Towers Skybridge & Observation Deck
Batu Caves Rainbow Steps & Lord Murugan Statue
Genting Highlands Skyway Cable Car & Theme Park

itinerary.title: Arrival in Singapore & Night Safari
itinerary.description: Arrive at Singapore Changi Airport. Transfer to hotel. Evening visit to the world's first Night Safari with guided tram ride through 7 geographical zones of nocturnal wildlife.

itinerary.title: Singapore City Tour & Gardens by the Bay
itinerary.description: City orientation: Merlion Park, Marina Bay Sands photo stop, Chinatown, Little India. Afternoon visit Gardens by the Bay (Flower Dome & Cloud Forest) and Supertree Grove Light Show.

itinerary.title: Full Day Universal Studios & Sentosa Island
itinerary.description: Full day at Sentosa Island with unlimited ride access to Universal Studios (Transformers, Jurassic Park, Battlestar Galactica), S.E.A. Aquarium, and Wings of Time laser show.

itinerary.title: Singapore to Kuala Lumpur via Malacca Heritage
itinerary.description: Scenic cross-border coach drive to Malaysia. Stop at UNESCO World Heritage city of Malacca (St. Paul's Hill, Dutch Square, Jonker Street). Arrive in Kuala Lumpur and check in.

itinerary.title: Kuala Lumpur City Tour & Petronas Twin Towers
itinerary.description: Tour King's Palace, National Monument, Independence Square, and ascend the iconic Petronas Twin Towers Skybridge & 86th Floor observation deck. Evening shopping at Bukit Bintang.

itinerary.title: Batu Caves & Genting Highlands Cable Car
itinerary.description: Visit the dramatic Batu Caves with 272 rainbow steps and 140ft golden Murugan statue. Board the Genting Skyway cable car to Genting Highlands mountain resort and theme parks.

itinerary.title: Putrajaya Tour & Sunway Lagoon
itinerary.description: Morning tour of administrative capital Putrajaya (Pink Mosque & Perdana Putra). Afternoon optional Sunway Lagoon mega theme park or shopping at Pavilion KL.

itinerary.title: Chocolates Shopping & KLIA Airport Departure
itinerary.description: Morning visit to Beryl's Chocolate Kingdom, last-minute shopping at Central Market, and transfer to Kuala Lumpur International Airport for your departure flight.

title: Maldives
description: Pure seclusion in the Indian Ocean — stay in luxury overwater bungalows perched directly above crystal turquoise lagoons, world-class coral reefs, and romantic sunset catamaran cruises.
highlights: Luxury Overwater Villa Stay with Direct Lagoon Ocean Access
Speedboat / Seaplane Airport Transfers across Turquoise Atolls
Sunset Dolphin Cruise with Complimentary Champagne & Canapes
House Reef Snorkeling with Manta Rays, Reef Sharks & Sea Turtles
Complimentary Non-Motorized Water Sports (Kayak, Paddleboard)
Romantic 4-Course Candlelight Dinner on Private White Sand Beach

itinerary.title: Velana Airport Arrival & Speedboat to Private Island
itinerary.description: Arrive at Velana International Airport in Male. VIP meet-and-greet, luxury speedboat transfer skimming over turquoise atolls to your private 5-star island resort. Check into your Overwater Villa.

itinerary.title: Coral Reef Snorkeling & Marine Exploration
itinerary.description: Morning guided snorkeling excursion along the resort's house reef to observe manta rays, clownfish, and reef sharks. Afternoon complimentary kayaking and stand-up paddleboarding.

itinerary.title: Sunset Dolphin Safari Cruise & Beach Dinner
itinerary.description: Leisure morning at your private villa sundeck. Late afternoon board a luxury dhoni boat for a Sunset Dolphin Cruise watching playful spinner dolphins, followed by private beach dinner.

itinerary.title: Island Wellness, Spa & Sandbank Picnic
itinerary.description: Indulge in holistic island spa therapy overlooking the ocean, enjoy a private castaway sandbank picnic, and take part in evening stingray and nurse shark feeding sessions.

itinerary.title: Floating Breakfast & Speedboat Departure
itinerary.description: Signature floating breakfast in your private pool overlooking the boundless Indian Ocean. Leisure swim, check-out, and speedboat transfer to Male Airport for flight home.

title: Vietnam
description: Journey through the captivating landscapes and rich heritage of Vietnam — emerald waters and limestone pillars of Ha Long Bay, lantern-lit alleys of Hoi An, and vibrant street life of Hanoi.
highlights: Overnight 5-Star Luxury Cruise on Ha Long Bay with Kayaking
Hoi An Ancient Town UNESCO Lantern-Lit Walking Tour
Ba Na Hills & Golden Giant Hands Bridge Cable Car
Hanoi Old Quarter 36 Streets Cyclo Ride & Water Puppet Show
Cu Chi Underground Guerrilla Tunnels Exploration
Mekong Delta Riverboat Cruise with Coconut Village Tour

itinerary.title: Arrival in Hanoi & Old Quarter Street Walk
itinerary.description: Arrive at Noi Bai International Airport in Hanoi. Transfer to hotel in the French Quarter. Evening street food tasting tour and cyclo ride around Hoan Kiem Lake.

itinerary.title: Hanoi City Tour & Water Puppet Show
itinerary.description: Visit Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum, One Pillar Pagoda, Temple of Literature (Vietnam's first university), and watch a traditional Thang Long Water Puppet performance.

itinerary.title: Hanoi to Ha Long Bay Overnight Luxury Cruise
itinerary.description: Drive to Ha Long Bay and board a luxury 5-star cruise. Sail past thousands of limestone karsts, visit Sung Sot Cave (Surprise Cave), kayak at Luon Cave, and sunset party on deck.

itinerary.title: Ha Long Bay Tai Chi & Flight to Da Nang
itinerary.description: Morning sunrise Tai Chi session on sundeck. Visit Titov Island for panoramic bay views. Brunch on board, disembark and transfer to Hanoi Airport for flight to Da Nang / Hoi An.

itinerary.title: Ba Na Hills & Golden Giant Hands Bridge
itinerary.description: Ride the world's longest single-wire cable car to Ba Na Hills. Walk across the iconic Golden Giant Hands Bridge, visit French Village, Fantasy Park, and Linh Ung Pagoda.

itinerary.title: Hoi An Ancient Town & Coconut Basket Boat
itinerary.description: Cam Thanh Coconut Village basket boat ride. Afternoon walking tour of UNESCO Hoi An: Japanese Covered Bridge, Tan Ky Old House, and evening release of floating flower lanterns on the river.

itinerary.title: Fly Da Nang to Ho Chi Minh City (Saigon)
itinerary.description: Fly to Ho Chi Minh City. Visit War Remnants Museum, Notre Dame Cathedral, Central Post Office, Reunification Palace, and Ben Thanh Market for shopping.

itinerary.title: Cu Chi Tunnels Historical Exploration
itinerary.description: Half-day trip to Cu Chi Tunnels. Explore the vast 250km underground network of tunnels, trapdoors, living quarters, and hospitals used during the Vietnam War.

itinerary.title: Mekong Delta Riverboat & Island Tour
itinerary.description: Excursion to My Tho in the Mekong Delta. Cruise the river by motorized boat and sampan through coconut canals, visit honey bee farms, fruit orchards, and enjoy traditional folk music.

itinerary.title: Saigon Shopping & Airport Departure
itinerary.description: Leisure morning for cafe hopping and shopping at Saigon Square. Private transfer to Tan Son Nhat International Airport for flight home.

title: Baku
description: Where ancient Silk Road history meets striking futuristic architecture — Azerbaijan's Land of Fire offers burning mountains, mud volcanoes, Caspian Sea boulevards, and Caucasian mountain landscapes.
highlights: Heydar Aliyev Center Architectural Masterpiece by Zaha Hadid
Gobustan National Park Petroglyphs & Active Mud Volcanoes
Ateshgah Fire Temple & Yanar Dag Eternal Burning Mountain
Icherisheher UNESCO Old City with Maiden Tower & Shirvanshahs Palace
Gabala Tufandag Mountain Ropeway & Nohur Lake Tour
Caspian Sea Boulevard, Little Venice & Flame Towers Light Show

itinerary.title: Arrival in Baku & Flame Towers Night View
itinerary.description: Arrive at Heydar Aliyev International Airport (GYD). Private VIP transfer to hotel. Evening visit to Highland Park for panoramic views of Baku Bay and illuminated Flame Towers.

itinerary.title: Baku Old City (Icherisheher) & Modern City Tour
itinerary.description: Explore UNESCO Icherisheher Old City, Maiden Tower, Palace of the Shirvanshahs, and Miniature Book Museum. Afternoon walk on Baku Boulevard, Little Venice boat ride, and Nizami Street.

itinerary.title: Gobustan Mud Volcanoes, Fire Temple & Yanar Dag
itinerary.description: Excursion to Gobustan Rock Art Cultural Landscape and bubbling Mud Volcanoes. Afternoon visit to ancient Ateshgah Zoroastrian Fire Temple and the natural burning gas fire at Yanar Dag.

itinerary.title: Day Trip to Gabala Mountain Resort
itinerary.description: Scenic drive through the Caucasus foothills to Gabala. Visit serene Nohur Lake, take the Tufandag Mountain Ropeway for panoramic alpine views, and visit 7 Beauties Waterfall.

itinerary.title: Shamakhi Historical Tour & Alpine Views
itinerary.description: Drive to Shamakhi ancient capital. Visit the historic Juma Mosque, Diri Baba Mausoleum carved into rock, and a local Caucasian winery for tea and local sweets.

itinerary.title: Heydar Aliyev Center & Shopping at Ganjlik Mall
itinerary.description: Visit the world-renowned Heydar Aliyev Cultural Center designed by Zaha Hadid. Afternoon shopping for local carpets, spices, and caviar at Yaşıl Bazar (Green Market) and modern malls.

itinerary.title: Baku Souvenirs & Airport Departure
itinerary.description: Leisurely breakfast, last-minute stroll along the Caspian Promenade, check-out, and private transfer to Baku International Airport for return flight.

title: Bhutan
description: The mystical Himalayan Kingdom of Gross National Happiness — hike to the iconic clifftop Tiger's Nest Monastery, cross high mountain passes adorned with prayer flags, and explore ancient Buddhist dzongs.
highlights: Hike to the Legendary Tiger's Nest (Taktsang Monastery) at 3,120m
Dochula Pass 108 Memorial Chortens & Himalayan Panoramic Peaks
Punakha Dzong — Palace of Great Happiness at River Confluence
Buddha Dordenma 169ft Giant Bronze Statue in Thimphu
Phobjikha Glacial Valley & Black-Necked Crane Sanctuary
Traditional Bhutanese Hot Stone Bath & Archery Experience

itinerary.title: Spectacular Flight to Paro & Drive to Thimphu
itinerary.description: Thrilling flight into Paro Valley with Everest and Kanchenjunga views. Meet our licensed Bhutanese guide and drive along Wangchu River to capital city Thimphu. Check-in and relax.

itinerary.title: Thimphu Sightseeing & Buddha Dordenma
itinerary.description: Visit the colossal Buddha Dordenma statue overlooking Thimphu valley, Memorial Chorten, National Institute of Zorig Chusum (13 Traditional Arts), and Tashichho Dzong fortress.

itinerary.title: Thimphu to Punakha via Dochula Pass
itinerary.description: Drive over Dochula Pass (3,100m) with 108 stupas and panoramic 360-degree snow peaks. Descend into subtropical Punakha valley and visit Chimi Lhakhang (Fertility Temple).

itinerary.title: Punakha Dzong & Longest Suspension Bridge
itinerary.description: Tour the magnificent Punakha Dzong situated at the confluence of Pho Chhu and Mo Chhu rivers. Walk across Bhutan's longest suspension bridge and hike to Khamsum Yulley Namgyal Chorten.

itinerary.title: Punakha to Phobjikha Valley (Gangtey)
itinerary.description: Scenic drive through dense rhododendron and oak forests to the glacial Phobjikha Valley. Visit 17th-century Gangtey Monastery and Black-Necked Crane Information Centre.

itinerary.title: Gangtey Nature Trail & Return to Paro
itinerary.description: Morning guided Gangtey Nature Trail through pine forests and alpine meadows. Scenic drive back to Paro valley. Visit Ta Dzong (National Museum) and Rinpung Dzong.

itinerary.title: Pilgrimage Hike to Tiger's Nest Monastery (Taktsang)
itinerary.description: Embark on the unforgettable 4-5 hour hike up through pine forests draped with Spanish moss to the dramatic cliff-hanging Paro Taktsang (Tiger's Nest) perched 900m above the valley.

itinerary.title: Chele La Pass (Highest Motorable Pass) & Haa Valley
itinerary.description: Drive to Chele La Pass at 3,988m with views of Mount Jomolhari. Excursion to pristine Haa Valley with visits to Lhakhang Karpo (White Temple) and Lhakhang Nagpo (Black Temple).

itinerary.title: Paro Cultural Experience & Traditional Hot Stone Bath
itinerary.description: Try traditional Bhutanese archery (national sport), visit local farmhouse, wear traditional Gho/Kira attire, and soothe muscles in a traditional herb-infused hot stone bath.

itinerary.title: Paro International Airport Departure
itinerary.description: Breakfast at resort. Bid farewell ("Tashi Delek") to your Bhutanese guide and transfer to Paro International Airport for departure.

title: Nepal Grand Explorer
description: A 15-day Nepal circuit connecting Kathmandu, Nagarkot, Pokhara, Bandipur, Chitwan and Lumbini. Long road journeys and overnight stops will be confirmed against practical travel conditions.
highlights: Kathmandu heritage sites
Nagarkot mountain viewpoints, weather permitting
Pokhara and Phewa Lake
Bandipur, Chitwan and Lumbini

itinerary.title: Arrival in Kathmandu
itinerary.description: Airport pickup, hotel check-in and rest.

itinerary.title: Kathmandu Heritage
itinerary.description: Visit Pashupatinath Temple, Boudhanath Stupa and other suitable heritage attractions.

itinerary.title: Kathmandu Valley
itinerary.description: Explore Kathmandu Durbar Square or another suitable heritage site.

itinerary.title: Kathmandu to Nagarkot
itinerary.description: Transfer to Nagarkot. Mountain views depend on weather.

itinerary.title: Nagarkot and Transfer Toward Pokhara
itinerary.description: Morning viewpoint visit and travel toward Pokhara with suitable breaks and overnight arrangements confirmed for practical travel times.

itinerary.title: Pokhara Sightseeing
itinerary.description: Visit Phewa Lake, Davis Falls and Gupteshwor Mahadev Cave, subject to opening and access.

itinerary.title: Pokhara Exploration
itinerary.description: Visit Sarangkot for sunrise if conditions permit. Explore additional local attractions.

itinerary.title: Pokhara to Bandipur
itinerary.description: Transfer to Bandipur and explore the heritage town.

itinerary.title: Bandipur to Chitwan
itinerary.description: Transfer to Chitwan, hotel check-in and local orientation.

itinerary.title: Chitwan Experience
itinerary.description: Permitted, responsible wildlife and nature activities, following park regulations.

itinerary.title: Chitwan to Lumbini
itinerary.description: Transfer to Lumbini. Visit the Maya Devi Temple area and sacred garden.

itinerary.title: Lumbini Exploration
itinerary.description: Explore selected monasteries and heritage sites.

itinerary.title: Return Toward Kathmandu
itinerary.description: Travel according to the confirmed transport plan and practical overnight arrangements.

itinerary.title: Kathmandu Leisure and Shopping
itinerary.description: Explore local markets or visit remaining attractions.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Airport transfer.

title: Kashmir & Himachal
description: Experience Paradise on Earth and the Land of the Gods — peaceful Dal Lake shikara rides, snow-bound Gulmarg Gondola, lush Pahalgam valleys, high Atal Tunnel, and Solang Valley adventures.
highlights: Dal Lake Luxury Houseboat Overnight Stay & Sunset Shikara Ride
Gulmarg Gondola Cable Car Ride to Kongdoori & Apharwat Peak
Pahalgam Valley of Shepherds, Betaab Valley & Aru Valley
Sonmarg Meadow of Gold & Thajiwas Glacier Trek
Manali Atal Tunnel, Sissu Waterfall & Solang Valley Snow Sports
Mughal Gardens: Shalimar Bagh, Nishat Bagh & Chashme Shahi

itinerary.title: Arrival in Srinagar & Dal Lake Houseboat
itinerary.description: Arrive at Srinagar International Airport. Warm Kashmiri welcome and transfer to luxury carved wooden houseboat on Dal Lake. Enjoy a relaxing sunset Shikara ride across Floating Gardens.

itinerary.title: Mughal Gardens & Shankaracharya Temple
itinerary.description: Explore Nishat Bagh (Garden of Bliss), Shalimar Bagh (Abode of Love), Chashme Shahi, and visit the hilltop Shankaracharya Temple for panoramic Srinagar city views.

itinerary.title: Gulmarg Gondola Ride & Snow Paradise
itinerary.description: Full-day excursion to Gulmarg (Meadow of Flowers) at 8,825ft. Ride the world-famous Gulmarg Gondola cable car up to Phase 1 & 2 for thrilling snow activities and alpine panorama.

itinerary.title: Pahalgam Valley of Shepherds & Betaab Valley
itinerary.description: Drive past saffron fields of Pampore and Awantipora ruins to Pahalgam. Visit scenic Betaab Valley, Aru Valley, and Chandanwari along the sparkling Lidder River.

itinerary.title: Sonmarg Excursion & Transfer to Dharamshala
itinerary.description: Drive to Sonmarg (Meadow of Gold) with views of Thajiwas Glacier and Sindh River. Scenic transfer towards Himachal Pradesh foothills into Dharamshala.

itinerary.title: Dharamshala to Manali via Kullu Valley
itinerary.description: Visit Dalai Lama Temple Complex and Bhagsu Waterfall in McLeodganj. Scenic drive to Manali via Kullu Valley with river rafting and Shawl Factory stops. Check-in in Manali.

itinerary.title: Atal Tunnel, Solang Valley & Sissu
itinerary.description: Drive through the engineering marvel Atal Tunnel (9.02km) into Lahaul Valley to visit Sissu Waterfall. Afternoon adventure sports at Solang Valley (Paragliding, Zorbing, Quad Biking).

itinerary.title: Manali Local Sightseeing & Chandigarh Departure
itinerary.description: Visit Hadimba Temple, Vashisht Hot Springs, and Mall Road. Scenic descent to Chandigarh Airport / Railway Station for departure.

title: Goa
description: Sun, sand, and spice — palm-fringed Arabian Sea beaches, historic Portuguese churches, thrilling water sports, Dudhsagar jungle waterfalls, and vibrant nightlife cafes.
highlights: Calangute, Baga & Anjuna Water Sports Combo (Parasailing, Jet Ski)
Dudhsagar 4-Tier Jungle Waterfall 4x4 Jeep Safari
Old Goa UNESCO Churches: Basilica of Bom Jesus & Se Cathedral
Mandovi River Sunset Luxury Cruise with Goan Folk Dance
Spice Plantation Guided Tour with Traditional Goan Buffet Lunch
Fort Aguada, Chapora "Dil Chahta Hai" Fort & Vagator Sunset

itinerary.title: Arrival in Goa & Beach Resort Check-in
itinerary.description: Arrive at Goa Airport (GOI/GOX). AC transfer to your beachfront resort. Evening at leisure strolling along Calangute / Candolim beach and enjoying beach shack dining.

itinerary.title: North Goa Beaches, Fort Aguada & Water Sports
itinerary.description: Visit historic 17th-century Portuguese Fort Aguada and lighthouse. Head to Baga Beach for thrilling water sports: Parasailing, Jet Ski, Banana Ride, and Bumper Ride.

itinerary.title: Anjuna, Vagator & Chapora Fort Sunset
itinerary.description: Explore Anjuna Beach, Vagator Beach rocky cliffs, and climb the iconic Chapora Fort overlooking the Arabian Sea. Evening explore Tito's Lane and local flea markets.

itinerary.title: Dudhsagar Waterfalls Safari & Spice Plantation
itinerary.description: Thrilling open 4x4 jeep safari through Bhagwan Mahavir Wildlife Sanctuary to Dudhsagar Waterfalls. Swim in natural pool. Visit Sahakari Spice Farm for guided tour and authentic buffet.

itinerary.title: South Goa Heritage Churches & Miramar Beach
itinerary.description: Tour UNESCO Old Goa: Basilica of Bom Jesus (St. Francis Xavier relics) and Se Cathedral. Visit Mangueshi Temple, Miramar Beach, Dona Paula viewpoint, and evening Mandovi River Sunset Cruise.

itinerary.title: Grand Island Boat Trip & Dolphin Spotting
itinerary.description: Scenic boat cruise to Grand Island. Spot playful wild dolphins, enjoy bottom fishing, snorkeling in calm bays, and a beachside BBQ lunch.

itinerary.title: Souvenir Shopping & Airport Departure
itinerary.description: Leisurely breakfast, shopping for Goan feni, cashews, spices, and souvenirs at Panaji Market. Private transfer to airport for departure.

title: Andaman
description: Pristine emerald islands surrounded by turquoise waters — white sands of Radhanagar Beach, crystal snorkeling at Elephant Beach, natural coral bridges, and historic Cellular Jail.
highlights: Radhanagar Beach on Havelock Island — Rated Asia's Best Beach
Elephant Beach Speedboat Ride with Coral Reef Snorkeling
Cellular Jail Light & Sound Show & Freedom Fighter Memorial
High-Speed Luxury Catamaran Cruise (Makruzz / Nautika)
Neil Island Natural Rock Bridge & Sunset at Laxmanpur Beach
Corbyn's Cove Coastal Drive & Coconut Palm Groves

itinerary.title: Port Blair Arrival & Cellular Jail Light Show
itinerary.description: Arrive at Veer Savarkar Airport in Port Blair. Transfer to hotel. Visit historic Cellular Jail national memorial, explore the museum, and witness the stirring evening Light and Sound show.

itinerary.title: High-Speed Cruise to Havelock & Radhanagar Beach
itinerary.description: Board luxury private catamaran (Makruzz/Nautika) to Havelock Island (Swaraj Dweep). Check into beach resort. Afternoon visit Radhanagar Beach (Beach No. 7) for a magical sunset.

itinerary.title: Elephant Beach Snorkeling & Water Sports
itinerary.description: Speedboat ride to Elephant Beach. Complimentary guided snorkeling session to observe vibrant live coral reefs, sea anemones, and schools of colorful tropical fish. Glass bottom boat ride.

itinerary.title: Neil Island Natural Bridge & Return to Port Blair
itinerary.description: Catamaran cruise to Neil Island (Shaheed Dweep). Visit the famous Natural Coral Rock Bridge and Laxmanpur Beach sunset point. Late afternoon cruise back to Port Blair.

itinerary.title: Sagarika Souvenir Emporium & Airport Departure
itinerary.description: Breakfast at hotel, shopping for sea shell handicrafts, pearl jewelry, and wood carvings at Sagarika Government Emporium. Transfer to airport for flight home.

title: Kerala
description: God's Own Country — cruise through tranquil emerald backwaters on a traditional thatched houseboat, wander misty tea plantations in Munnar, and rejuvenate with authentic Ayurvedic wellness.
highlights: Alleppey Private Luxury Houseboat Overnight Backwater Cruise
Munnar Rolling Tea Gardens, Eravikulam Nilgiri Tahr Sanctuary & Mattupetty
Thekkady Periyar Wildlife Sanctuary Boat Safari & Spice Walk
Fort Kochi Chinese Fishing Nets, Jew Town & Kathakali Dance Show
Kovalam Crescent Lighthouse Beach & Samudra Beach
Complimentary Rejuvenating Herbal Ayurvedic Massage Session

itinerary.title: Arrival in Cochin & Heritage Fort Kochi
itinerary.description: Arrive at Cochin International Airport (COK). Visit Fort Kochi, Chinese Fishing Nets, St. Francis Church, Santa Cruz Basilica, Jew Town, and attend an evening Kathakali cultural dance show.

itinerary.title: Cochin to Munnar via Cheeyappara Waterfalls
itinerary.description: Scenic 4-hour drive climbing into the Western Ghats past rubber plantations, spice groves, and cascading Cheeyappara and Valara Waterfalls. Check into hill resort in Munnar.

itinerary.title: Munnar Tea Gardens & Eravikulam National Park
itinerary.description: Visit Eravikulam National Park (home to endangered Nilgiri Tahr mountain goat), Tea Museum with live processing, Mattupetty Dam, Echo Point, and Kundala Lake.

itinerary.title: Munnar to Thekkady & Periyar Wildlife Safari
itinerary.description: Scenic drive to Thekkady. Visit an aromatic spice plantation (cardamom, pepper, cinnamon). Afternoon boat safari on Periyar Lake in the heart of the tiger & elephant reserve.

itinerary.title: Thekkady to Alleppey Private Houseboat Cruise
itinerary.description: Drive to Alleppey (Venice of the East). Board your private AC luxury houseboat. Cruise through narrow canals, palm-fringed lagoons, and paddy fields with freshly cooked Kerala feast.

itinerary.title: Alleppey to Kovalam Beach Resort
itinerary.description: Disembark houseboat after breakfast. Drive south along the coast to Kovalam. Check into beach resort. Afternoon relaxation on the golden sands of Lighthouse Beach.

itinerary.title: Trivandrum Sightseeing & Airport Departure
itinerary.description: Visit Sree Padmanabhaswamy Temple (exterior) and Napier Museum in Trivandrum. Private transfer to Trivandrum / Cochin Airport for flight home.

title: Seven Sisters
description: Journey across Northeast India's unexplored wonderland — Meghalaya's living root bridges, crystal-clear Dawki River, Kaziranga one-horned rhinos, Arunachal snow peaks, and vibrant tribal traditions.
highlights: Double Decker Living Root Bridge Trek in Nongriat (Meghalaya)
Dawki Umngot River Boating over Crystal Clear Floating Waters
Kaziranga National Park Elephant & Open Jeep Safari (One-Horned Rhinos)
Mawlynnong — Asia's Cleanest Village & Balancing Rock
Cherrapunji Nohkalikai Falls & Mawsmai Limestone Caves
Kamakhya Devi Temple & Brahmaputra Sunset River Cruise

itinerary.title: Guwahati Arrival & Kamakhya Temple to Shillong
itinerary.description: Arrive at Guwahati Airport. Visit sacred Kamakhya Temple. Scenic drive to Shillong (Scotland of the East) with photo stop at picturesque Umiam Lake (Barapani). Check-in in Shillong.

itinerary.title: Shillong to Cherrapunji Waterfalls & Caves
itinerary.description: Drive to Cherrapunji (Sohra). Marvel at Nohkalikai Falls (India's tallest plunge waterfall), Seven Sisters Falls, Mawsmai limestone cave, and Eco Park overlooking Bangladesh plains.

itinerary.title: Nongriat Double Decker Living Root Bridge Trek
itinerary.description: Trek down into the lush tropical rainforest to the ancient bio-engineered Double Decker Living Root Bridge and natural turquoise rock pools of Rainbow Falls.

itinerary.title: Dawki Crystal River & Mawlynnong Cleanest Village
itinerary.description: Visit Mawlynnong (Asia's cleanest village) and Living Root Bridge. Drive to Dawki on the Indo-Bangladesh border for a magical boat ride on crystal-clear Umngot River.

itinerary.title: Shillong Sightseeing & Transfer to Kaziranga
itinerary.description: Visit Don Bosco Museum, Elephant Falls, and Shillong Peak. Scenic drive across Brahmaputra Valley to Kaziranga National Park UNESCO World Heritage Site.

itinerary.title: Kaziranga Elephant & Jeep Safari
itinerary.description: Early morning elephant safari in Central / Western Range for close-up sightings of Great Indian One-Horned Rhinoceros. Afternoon 4x4 open jeep safari and visit to Kaziranga Orchid Park.

itinerary.title: Kaziranga to Bhalukpong / Tezpur Cultural Tour
itinerary.description: Drive along the foothills of Arunachal Pradesh. Visit ancient Tezpur Agnigarh ruins and Mahabhairab Temple. Evening traditional Assamese Bihu cultural dance performance.

itinerary.title: Guwahati Brahmaputra Cruise & Airport Departure
itinerary.description: Drive back to Guwahati. Brief Brahmaputra riverfront visit and timely transfer to Guwahati Airport for your flight back home.

title: Rajasthan
description: The Land of Kings — golden desert sands of Jaisalmer, majestic forts of Jaipur and Jodhpur, romantic lake palaces of Udaipur, camel safaris, and vibrant royal Rajput heritage.
highlights: Jaipur Amber Fort Elephant / Jeep Ride & Hawa Mahal
Jaisalmer Sam Sand Dunes Luxury Swiss Tent Camp with DJ & Bonfire
Sunset Camel Safari & Thar Desert 4x4 Dune Bashing
Mehrangarh Fort Guided Tour & Jodhpur Blue City Walk
Udaipur Lake Pichola Boat Ride & Royal City Palace Complex
Authentic Rajasthani Chokhi Dhani Cultural Village Feast

itinerary.title: Arrival in Jaipur (Pink City) & Chokhi Dhani
itinerary.description: Arrive at Jaipur Airport / Station. Check into heritage hotel. Evening visit Chokhi Dhani ethnic resort for Rajasthani folk dances, camel rides, puppet shows, and authentic thali feast.

itinerary.title: Jaipur Forts, Palaces & Hawa Mahal
itinerary.description: Ascend Amber Fort on elephant / jeep. Photo stop at Jal Mahal. Visit City Palace royal museum, Jantar Mantar UNESCO observatory, and iconic Hawa Mahal (Palace of Winds).

itinerary.title: Jaipur to Jodhpur (Blue City) via Pushkar
itinerary.description: Drive to Jodhpur via holy Pushkar. Visit sacred Brahma Temple and holy Pushkar Lake. Continue to Jodhpur, check into heritage haveli hotel.

itinerary.title: Mehrangarh Fort & Drive to Jaisalmer Dunes
itinerary.description: Tour the invincible Mehrangarh Fort and Jaswant Thada marble cenotaph. Scenic drive across Thar Desert to Jaisalmer Sam Sand Dunes. Luxury Swiss tent check-in, camel safari, and cultural gala.

itinerary.title: Jaisalmer Golden Fort & Kuldhara Haunted Village
itinerary.description: Explore living Jaisalmer Golden Fort (Sonar Qila), Patwon Ki Haveli, Salim Singh Ki Haveli, and eerie Kuldhara abandoned haunted village.

itinerary.title: Jaisalmer to Udaipur (City of Lakes)
itinerary.description: Drive to romantic Udaipur via Ranakpur Jain Temples with 1,444 uniquely carved marble pillars. Arrive in Udaipur, evening sunset boat ride on Lake Pichola past Lake Palace.

itinerary.title: Udaipur City Palace & Airport Departure
itinerary.description: Visit majestic Udaipur City Palace complex, Saheliyon Ki Bari, and Jagdish Temple. Timely transfer to Udaipur Airport / Railway Station for departure.

title: Sikkim
description: The Himalayan kingdom of glaciers and monasteries — holy Tsomgo Lake, sacred Gurudongmar Lake at 17,800ft, Yumthang Valley of Flowers, and spellbinding views of Mount Kanchenjunga.
highlights: Gurudongmar Holy Lake at 17,800ft — One of the Highest Lakes in the World
Tsomgo (Changu) Glacial Lake & Baba Harbhajan Singh Mandir
Yumthang Valley of Flowers & Shingba Rhododendron Sanctuary
Pelling Skywalk & Spectacular Kanchenjunga Sunrise View
Rumtek Monastery & Enchey Monastery Buddhist Circuits
Lachen & Lachung Remote Alpine Village Wooden Homestays

itinerary.title: Bagdogra Arrival & Scenic Drive to Gangtok
itinerary.description: Arrive at Bagdogra Airport (IXB) / NJP Railway Station. Scenic drive alongside Teesta River into Sikkim capital Gangtok. Evening stroll on MG Marg pedestrian mall.

itinerary.title: Tsomgo Glacial Lake & Baba Mandir
itinerary.description: Excursion to sacred Tsomgo Lake (12,400ft) surrounded by snow-capped mountains. Visit Baba Harbhajan Singh Memorial Temple and enjoy yak rides along the lake.

itinerary.title: Gangtok to Lachen via Chungthang Waterfalls
itinerary.description: Scenic drive to North Sikkim village of Lachen (8,830ft). Stop at Seven Sisters Waterfalls, Naga Falls, and Singhik Viewpoint. Overnight in peaceful alpine wooden lodge.

itinerary.title: Gurudongmar Lake (17,800ft) & Lachung
itinerary.description: Early morning expedition to sacred Gurudongmar Lake at 17,800ft with crystal blue frozen waters. Return to Lachen, lunch, and drive to picturesque Lachung village.

itinerary.title: Yumthang Valley of Flowers & Return to Gangtok
itinerary.description: Visit Yumthang Valley (11,800ft) blooming with wild rhododendrons and alpine hot springs. Optional Zero Point snow excursion. Return drive to Gangtok hotel.

itinerary.title: Gangtok to Pelling via Ravangla Buddha Park
itinerary.description: Drive to Pelling in West Sikkim. En route visit the breathtaking Tathagata Tsal (Buddha Park) with 130ft Buddha statue set against Himalayan peaks. Check-in in Pelling.

itinerary.title: Pelling Glass Skywalk & Pemayangtse Monastery
itinerary.description: Visit Pelling Glass Skywalk, Chenrezig Statue, Pemayangtse Monastery, Rabdentse Palace ruins, and Kanchenjunga Waterfalls with majestic sunrise view of Mt. Kanchenjunga.

itinerary.title: Pelling to Bagdogra / NJP Departure
itinerary.description: Breakfast with panoramic mountain views. Scenic descent through tea gardens to Bagdogra Airport / NJP Station for return flight.

title: Ayodhya & Varanasi Spiritual Tour
description: Experience Ayodhya and Varanasi through sacred temples, historic ghats, river aarti ceremonies and an excursion to Sarnath. Temple access and ceremonies are subject to current arrangements.
highlights: Ram Janmabhoomi, Hanuman Garhi and Ayodhya heritage
Saryu Aarti and riverfront
Kashi Vishwanath Temple and Varanasi ghats
Sarnath stupas and archaeological heritage

itinerary.title: Arrival in Ayodhya
itinerary.description: Pickup from Ayodhya railway station or airport. Hotel transfer, check-in and relaxation. Visit Shri Ram Janmabhoomi Mandir, subject to applicable entry arrangements, then Hanuman Garhi, Kanak Bhawan and Dashrath Mahal as time permits. Evening Saryu Aarti. Overnight in Ayodhya.

itinerary.title: Ayodhya Temple and Heritage Tour
itinerary.description: After breakfast, visit Nageshwar Nath Temple and Treta Ke Thakur subject to access. Explore Ram Ki Paidi, the Saryu riverfront and Guptar Ghat subject to schedule, then local markets. Overnight in Ayodhya.

itinerary.title: Ayodhya to Varanasi
itinerary.description: Breakfast and checkout, then road transfer to Varanasi (estimated 4–5 hours, subject to route and traffic). Hotel check-in and evening Ganga Aarti at Dashashwamedh Ghat. Overnight in Varanasi.

itinerary.title: Varanasi Temples and Ghats
itinerary.description: Optional early morning Ganges boat ride. Explore ghats subject to boat route and access. Visit Kashi Vishwanath, Annapurna and Kaal Bhairav temples; Sankat Mochan, Durga Temple and BHU area as time permits. Overnight in Varanasi.

itinerary.title: Sarnath Excursion
itinerary.description: Visit Dhamek Stupa, Chaukhandi Stupa, Sarnath Archaeological Museum and Mulagandha Kuti Vihara subject to opening hours. Return to Varanasi and explore Assi Ghat and local markets. Overnight in Varanasi.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Breakfast and checkout. Optional final temple visit depending on departure time, then transfer to Varanasi airport or railway station.

title: Uttarakhand Char Dham Yatra
description: A pilgrimage journey covering Yamunotri, Gangotri, Kedarnath and Badrinath, subject to seasonal access and current pilgrimage arrangements.
highlights: Yamunotri and Gangotri darshan
Kedarnath pilgrimage route
Badrinath Temple
Seasonal Himalayan road journey

itinerary.title: Arrival in Haridwar or Dehradun
itinerary.description: Pickup, hotel check-in and trip briefing. Overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Haridwar/Dehradun to Barkot
itinerary.description: Scenic drive toward Barkot. Rest and preparation for the Yamunotri visit. Overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Yamunotri Darshan
itinerary.description: Travel to the appropriate trek starting point. Visit Yamunotri Temple subject to weather and access, then return to Barkot. Overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Barkot to Uttarkashi
itinerary.description: Breakfast and transfer to Uttarkashi. Visit local temples if time permits. Overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Gangotri Darshan
itinerary.description: Excursion to Gangotri Temple and return to Uttarkashi. Overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Uttarkashi to Guptkashi
itinerary.description: Scenic mountain drive to Guptkashi. Rest and overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Kedarnath Pilgrimage
itinerary.description: Transfer to the designated Kedarnath route starting point. Trek or use officially available authorized transport, subject to availability and conditions. Darshan and overnight arrangements follow the selected package and current local rules.

itinerary.title: Kedarnath Route to Guptkashi
itinerary.description: Return according to the approved itinerary and travel conditions. Overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Guptkashi to Badrinath
itinerary.description: Transfer to Badrinath and visit Badrinath Temple subject to opening hours. Overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Badrinath and Return Journey
itinerary.description: Morning darshan if possible. Visit Mana village only if included, accessible and practical, then travel toward the designated overnight stop.

itinerary.title: Return to Haridwar or Dehradun
itinerary.description: Transfer and departure.

title: Cochin, Munnar, Thekkady & Alleppey
description: Discover Kerala’s hill stations, tea plantations, wildlife landscapes and tranquil backwaters on a focused 6-day route.
highlights: Fort Kochi and Chinese fishing nets
Munnar tea country and viewpoints
Thekkady spice country
Alleppey backwaters

itinerary.title: Arrival in Cochin
itinerary.description: Airport or railway station pickup and hotel check-in. Explore Fort Kochi and the Chinese fishing nets if time permits. Overnight in Cochin.

itinerary.title: Cochin to Munnar
itinerary.description: Breakfast and scenic drive to Munnar. Stop at Cheeyappara Waterfalls if accessible and explore tea plantations. Overnight in Munnar.

itinerary.title: Munnar Sightseeing
itinerary.description: Visit Eravikulam National Park if open and tickets are available. Explore Mattupetty Dam, Echo Point and a tea museum where available. Overnight in Munnar.

itinerary.title: Munnar to Thekkady
itinerary.description: Transfer to Thekkady. Visit a spice plantation or explore local attractions. Optional authorized wildlife or boating activity subject to availability. Overnight in Thekkady.

itinerary.title: Thekkady to Alleppey
itinerary.description: Transfer to Alleppey. Backwater cruise or houseboat experience only if selected and confirmed. Overnight according to the package arrangement.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Breakfast and checkout. Transfer to Cochin airport or railway station according to the confirmed itinerary.

title: Dalhousie, Chamba, Dharamshala & Amritsar
description: A Himalayan and Punjab heritage route linking Khajjiar and Chamba with Dharamshala and Amritsar.
highlights: Khajjiar and Dalhousie viewpoints
Chamba heritage and markets
Dharamshala and McLeod Ganj
Golden Temple and Jallianwala Bagh

itinerary.title: Arrival and Transfer to Dalhousie
itinerary.description: Pickup, transfer and hotel check-in. Leisure time. Overnight in Dalhousie.

itinerary.title: Dalhousie Sightseeing
itinerary.description: Visit Khajjiar subject to weather and road access. Explore local viewpoints and churches. Overnight in Dalhousie.

itinerary.title: Chamba Excursion
itinerary.description: Visit Chamba town and heritage attractions, local markets and scenic viewpoints. Overnight in Dalhousie or Chamba according to the final route.

itinerary.title: Transfer to Dharamshala
itinerary.description: Scenic transfer to Dharamshala. Explore McLeod Ganj if time permits. Overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Dharamshala Sightseeing
itinerary.description: Visit the Dalai Lama Temple complex, Bhagsunag area and local viewpoints as permitted. Overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Dharamshala to Amritsar
itinerary.description: Transfer to Amritsar and visit the Golden Temple. Overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Amritsar Sightseeing
itinerary.description: Visit Jallianwala Bagh. Optional Wagah-Attari border ceremony subject to current access and timing. Overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Breakfast and transfer to the airport or railway station.

title: Udaipur & Chittorgarh Heritage Tour
description: Explore Udaipur’s lakeside heritage and the monumental fort complex of Chittorgarh.
highlights: Lake Pichola and Udaipur lakeside
City Palace and Jagdish Temple
Chittorgarh Fort and Vijay Stambh
Rajasthan heritage and local markets

itinerary.title: Arrival in Udaipur
itinerary.description: Hotel check-in. Explore Lake Pichola and the lakeside area. Overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Udaipur Sightseeing
itinerary.description: Visit City Palace, Jagdish Temple and Saheliyon Ki Bari. Optional Lake Pichola boat ride subject to operation. Overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Udaipur to Chittorgarh
itinerary.description: Transfer to Chittorgarh. Explore Chittorgarh Fort, Vijay Stambh and key heritage sites where accessible. Overnight according to the package plan.

itinerary.title: Chittorgarh to Udaipur
itinerary.description: Breakfast and return to Udaipur. Explore local markets and cultural attractions. Overnight in Udaipur.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Breakfast, checkout and transfer to the departure point.

title: Odisha Cultural Explorer
description: Explore Odisha’s temples, heritage, coastal landscapes and cultural attractions on a practical route finalized for the selected dates.
highlights: Bhubaneswar temples and heritage
Jagannath Temple and Puri coast
Konark Sun Temple and Chandrabhaga Beach
Chilika Lake subject to permitted boating and seasonal availability

itinerary.title: Arrival in Bhubaneswar
itinerary.description: Pickup and hotel check-in. Visit local temples if time permits.

itinerary.title: Bhubaneswar Heritage
itinerary.description: Visit Lingaraj Temple, Mukteshwar Temple and selected heritage sites subject to access.

itinerary.title: Bhubaneswar to Puri
itinerary.description: Transfer to Puri. Visit the beach and local attractions.

itinerary.title: Puri Sightseeing
itinerary.description: Visit Jagannath Temple according to applicable entry rules. Explore local markets and the beach.

itinerary.title: Konark Excursion
itinerary.description: Visit Konark Sun Temple and Chandrabhaga Beach. Return to Puri or stay according to the confirmed itinerary.

itinerary.title: Chilika Lake Excursion
itinerary.description: Travel to a suitable Chilika Lake access point. Boating or birdwatching only when available and permitted.

itinerary.title: Odisha Heritage Route
itinerary.description: Transfer to another suitable Odisha heritage destination using a practical route based on the selected package; visit local cultural attractions.

itinerary.title: Return Toward Bhubaneswar
itinerary.description: Explore remaining attractions or local shopping. Overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Hotel checkout and airport or railway station transfer.

title: Manali – Leh Biking Expedition
description: The definitive high-altitude motorcycle and biking odyssey across the Himalayas. Cross legendary high passes including Rohtang Pass, Baralacha La, Nakee La, Lachung La, and Tanglang La into the mystic moonscapes of Ladakh.
highlights: Ride through Atal Tunnel, Baralacha La (16,040ft) & Tanglang La (17,480ft)
Dramatic Gata Loops 21 hairpin bends & Morey Plains throttle run
Khardung La (18,380ft) world’s highest motorable pass crossing
Pangong Tso high-altitude turquoise lake ride & campsite
Dedicated backup vehicle, certified mechanic, oxygen & spares

itinerary.title: Arrival in Manali & Briefing Session
itinerary.description: Assemble at Manali base camp, machine allocation, gear check, and orientation ride to Solang Valley.

itinerary.title: Manali to Jispa via Atal Tunnel & Keylong
itinerary.description: Ride through the engineering wonder Atal Tunnel into Lahaul Valley. Cruise along Bhaga River to Jispa campsite (10,500ft).

itinerary.title: Jispa to Sarchu via Baralacha La & Deepak Tal
itinerary.description: Cross Deepak Tal & Suraj Tal lakes before tackling snowbound Baralacha La (16,040ft) to reach Sarchu plateau.

itinerary.title: Sarchu to Leh via Gata Loops & Tanglang La
itinerary.description: Conquer the 21 hairpin bends of Gata Loops, Nakee La, Lachung La, and Tanglang La (17,480ft) descending into Leh.

itinerary.title: Leh Acclimatization & Local Monasteries
itinerary.description: Rest and acclimatize in Leh. Explore Shanti Stupa, Leh Palace, Hall of Fame, and vibrant local bazaar.

itinerary.title: Leh to Nubra Valley via Khardung La (18,380ft)
itinerary.description: Ascend the legendary Khardung La pass into the Valley of Flowers. Ride double-humped Bactrian camels at Hunder sand dunes.

itinerary.title: Nubra to Pangong Tso Lake & Return to Leh
itinerary.description: Ride along the Shyok River to magical Pangong Tso lake (14,270ft). Spend time by the azure shores and ride back to Leh via Chang La.

itinerary.title: Leh Airport Departure
itinerary.description: Farewell breakfast with the riding crew. Drop-off at Kushok Bakula Rimpochee Airport (IXL) for flight home.

title: Leh – Ladakh Biking Circuit
description: Explore the Crown of the Himalayas on two wheels. A comprehensive circuit covering the high passes, ancient cliffside monasteries, Turtuk Balti village, and high-altitude lakes of Ladakh.
highlights: Conquer Khardung La (18,380ft) & Chang La (17,590ft)
Border village ride to Turtuk (Baltistan culture)
Stargazing at Pangong Tso high-altitude campsite
Magnetic Hill & Sangam (Indus & Zanskar confluence)
Thiksey & Diskit Monastery colossal Maitreya Buddha

itinerary.title: Leh Arrival & Mandatory Acclimatization
itinerary.description: Arrive at Leh Airport (11,562ft). Full day rest for high-altitude acclimatization. Evening light walk around Leh Market.

itinerary.title: Leh Local, Shey & Thiksey Monasteries
itinerary.description: Test ride along Indus River to Shey Palace, 12-storey Thiksey Monastery, and sunset from Shanti Stupa.

itinerary.title: Leh to Nubra Valley via Khardung La (18,380ft)
itinerary.description: Ascend the world's highest motorable pass Khardung La. Descend into Nubra Valley and explore Diskit Monastery and Hunder Dunes.

itinerary.title: Nubra Valley to Turtuk Village & Back to Hunder
itinerary.description: Ride to India’s northernmost outpost Turtuk in Baltistan along the LOC. Experience apricot orchards and Balti cuisine.

itinerary.title: Nubra Valley to Pangong Tso via Shyok River
itinerary.description: Ride through dramatic gorges along the Shyok River directly to Pangong Tso lake (14,270ft). Overnight camping near the lake.

itinerary.title: Pangong Tso Sunrise & Ride to Leh via Chang La
itinerary.description: Witness color-shifting sunrise over Pangong lake. Ride over Chang La pass (17,590ft) back to Leh.

itinerary.title: Leh Valley, Magnetic Hill, Gurudwara & Sangam
itinerary.description: Ride to the gravity-defying Magnetic Hill, Gurudwara Pathar Sahib, and the dramatic Indus-Zanskar Sangam confluence.

itinerary.title: Leh Airport Departure
itinerary.description: Check-out from Leh hotel and transfer to airport with lifetime memories of the trans-Himalayan ride.

title: Winter Spiti Expedition
description: The ultimate white winter expedition into the frozen wonderland of Spiti Valley. Drive over snow-clad Himalayan terrain, witness frozen waterfalls, encounter Himalayan wildlife, and stay in warm local homestays.
highlights: Frozen Spiti Valley landscapes and snow leopard habitat zones
Century-old Key Monastery perched like a fortress in snow
World’s highest post office at Hikkim & highest village at Komic
Traditional heated homestays with warm Spitian hospitality
Experienced mountain 4x4 drivers with snow chains

itinerary.title: Shimla Arrival & Scenic Drive to Narkanda
itinerary.description: Arrive in Shimla, drive into the apple bowl of Narkanda. Check-in and enjoy panoramic snow vistas of Hatu Peak.

itinerary.title: Narkanda to Sangla / Chitkul in Kinnaur
itinerary.description: Descend along the roaring Sutlej River through Kinnaur Gate to the fairy-tale valley of Sangla and India’s last village Chitkul.

itinerary.title: Chitkul to Kalpa with Kinner Kailash View
itinerary.description: Drive to Kalpa village. Marvel at the sacred 6,050m Kinner Kailash peak changing colors during sunset.

itinerary.title: Kalpa to Nako & 1000-Year Tabo Monastery
itinerary.description: Enter the cold desert terrain of Spiti. Visit frozen Nako Lake and the UNESCO World Heritage Tabo Monastery complex.

itinerary.title: Tabo to Kaza via Cliffside Dhankar Monastery
itinerary.description: Drive to Dhankar Monastery perched on a dramatic cliff overlooking Spiti & Pin river confluence. Arrive in winter capital Kaza.

itinerary.title: Kaza - Key Monastery & Kibber Snow Expedition
itinerary.description: Visit snow-covered Key Monastery and Kibber village (14,200ft) known as prime Snow Leopard territory. Tea with monks.

itinerary.title: Kaza - Hikkim, Komic & Langza Fossil Village
itinerary.description: Visit Hikkim (world’s highest post office), Komic (highest motorable village), and the giant Buddha statue at Langza.

itinerary.title: Kaza Snow Safari & Local Homestay Experience
itinerary.description: Excursion through Chicham Bridge (highest suspension bridge in Asia) and immerse in warm Spitian homestay culinary traditions.

itinerary.title: Kaza to Kalpa / Rampur Return Journey
itinerary.description: Begin return drive through the scenic trans-Himalayan gorge roads. Overnight stay in Kalpa or Rampur.

itinerary.title: Drive to Shimla / Chandigarh Departure
itinerary.description: Scenic drive back to Shimla/Chandigarh railway station or airport for return journey home.

title: Mountaineering Expedition
description: A serious alpine mountaineering program designed for aspiring climbers and peak baggers. Learn glacier navigation, ice-axe arrest, crevasse rescue, and push for a high Himalayan summit ridge.
highlights: Technical glacier traverse, rope-team coordination & ice craft
Certified IMF / UIAGM lead mountain instructors
Summit ridge attempt with 360-degree Himalayan views
High-altitude alpine dome expedition tents & nutritious meals
Full mountaineering certification upon successful completion

itinerary.title: Base Camp Assembly & Gear Check
itinerary.description: Assemble at roadhead base camp, gear inspection, harness fitment, and briefing by expedition leader.

itinerary.title: Acclimatization Hike & Technical Training
itinerary.description: Gradual ascent to intermediate ridge. Practice knot-tying, rope coordination, and high-altitude breathing techniques.

itinerary.title: Ascend to Camp 1 (13,500ft)
itinerary.description: Trek through alpine moraine to establish Camp 1. Set up high-altitude four-season dome tents.

itinerary.title: Glacier Traverse & Ice Climbing Drills
itinerary.description: Rope up on the glacier. Hands-on training on crampon technique, front-pointing, and self-arrest with ice axes.

itinerary.title: Push to Advance Base Camp (15,200ft)
itinerary.description: Ascent to Advance Base Camp beneath the summit pyramid. Early evening carb-loading dinner and rest.

itinerary.title: Summit Ridge Push & Descend to Camp 1
itinerary.description: Midnight alpine start for the summit push. Reach the summit ridge at sunrise. Celebrate and safely descend to Camp 1.

itinerary.title: Return to Base Camp & Celebration
itinerary.description: Trek down to main Base Camp. Debriefing session, certificate distribution, and celebratory campfire dinner.

itinerary.title: Debrief & Departure
itinerary.description: Farewell breakfast with instructors and mountain crew before transfer to nearest railway station.

title: Mountain Trekking & Alpine Camping
description: A classic wilderness trek through lush pine forests, bubbling glacial streams, blooming rhododendron meadows, and panoramic Himalayan viewpoints. Perfect for nature lovers and avid hikers.
highlights: Lush alpine meadows (Bugyals) and dense cedar forests
Spectacular 360° panoramic sunrise views of snow ranges
Wilderness riverside camping beneath starry constellations
Experienced trek leaders, camp cooks & medical kits
Clean eco-friendly camping following Leave No Trace principles

itinerary.title: Base Town Arrival & Scenic Drive to Trailhead
itinerary.description: Assemble at base town, scenic mountain drive to the starting village trailhead. Camp orientation and evening acclimatization walk.

itinerary.title: Trek through Pine Forests to Alpine Meadow Camp
itinerary.description: Ascend through fragrant pine, oak, and deodar forests alongside gushing mountain streams. Pitch tents in scenic meadow.

itinerary.title: Ridge Trail to High Glacial Ridge Camp
itinerary.description: Climb above tree line onto the open ridges. Enjoy uninterrupted vistas of towering snow-capped peaks.

itinerary.title: Summit Viewpoint Trek & Sunset Campfire
itinerary.description: Trek to highest panoramic viewpoint. Enjoy lunch with 360-degree mountain horizons. Evening stargazing and campfire stories.

itinerary.title: Descent through Alpine Valleys to Base Village
itinerary.description: Gradual descent through picturesque mountain hamlets and terraced fields. Return to base camp lodge.

itinerary.title: Farewell Breakfast & Departure Transfer
itinerary.description: Hearty breakfast with fellow trekkers before departure transfers to transport hub.

title: Brahmatal Snow Trek
description: One of the finest winter snow treks in the Himalayas offering grand views of Mt. Trishul and Nanda Ghunti reflecting on the frozen Brahmatal Lake. Walk along snowy ridgelines and camp under starry mountain skies.
highlights: Frozen glacial lake of Brahmatal nestled at 12,250ft
Unmatched close-up vistas of Mt. Trishul (7,120m) & Nanda Ghunti
Snow-covered rhododendron and silver oak forests
Ridge walking along snow-laden trails
Ganges river rafting in Rishikesh on return leg

itinerary.title: Rishikesh to Lohajung Base Village Drive
itinerary.description: Scenic 10-hour drive along the Alaknanda and Mandakini rivers through Devprayag and Karnaprayag to Lohajung (7,600ft).

itinerary.title: Lohajung to Bekaltal Camp via Oak Forests
itinerary.description: Trek 6km through enchanting oak and rhododendron forests with views of Wan village. Camp by the peaceful Bekaltal lake.

itinerary.title: Bekaltal to Brahmatal Camp with Trishul Views
itinerary.description: Ascend through forest trails opening into expansive snow meadows. Majestic views of Mt. Trishul as you reach Brahmatal camp (10,440ft).

itinerary.title: Brahmatal Summit Push (12,250ft) & Khorurai
itinerary.description: Early morning climb to Brahmatal Pass and frozen lake. 360-degree panorama of Trishul, Nanda Ghunti, and Chaukhamba. Descend to Khorurai.

itinerary.title: Khorurai to Lohajung Descent
itinerary.description: Trek back down through oak trees into Lohajung base village. Evening hot showers, celebration dinner, and rest.

itinerary.title: Lohajung Rest & Local Village Exploration
itinerary.description: Leisure day in Lohajung. Visit local mountain homes, explore traditional Garhwali culture, and witness alpine sunsets.

itinerary.title: Lohajung to Auli / Joshimath Excursion
itinerary.description: Scenic drive to Joshimath and Auli. Enjoy views of Nanda Devi peak and explore the Himalayan ropeway viewpoints.

itinerary.title: Joshimath to Rishikesh via Devprayag Sangam
itinerary.description: Drive back along the sacred river valleys. Stop at Devprayag (confluence of Bhagirathi and Alaknanda). Check-in at Rishikesh.

itinerary.title: Rishikesh River Rafting & Departure
itinerary.description: Morning white water rafting on the Ganges through rapids like Roller Coaster and Golf Course. Departure transfer.

title: Kedarkantha Snow Summit Trek
description: The quintessential winter wonderland trek. Climb to the dramatic pyramid summit of Kedarkantha at 12,500ft, camp beside the frozen Juda Ka Talab lake, and gaze upon 13 prominent Himalayan peaks.
highlights: 360° summit views of Swargarohini, Black Peak, Bandarpoonch
Juda Ka Talab — magical frozen alpine lake campsite
Snow sliding and descent through untouched winter powder
Traditional wooden architecture homestay in Sankri village
Tons River pine valley riverside camping experience

itinerary.title: Dehradun to Sankri Base Village Drive
itinerary.description: Scenic drive through Mussoorie, Nainbagh, Purola, and Mori along the Tons River into Govind National Park base Sankri (6,400ft).

itinerary.title: Sankri to Juda Ka Talab Frozen Lake Camp
itinerary.description: Trek 4km through dense pine and maple forests. Arrive at the mystical frozen lake Juda Ka Talab (9,100ft) surrounded by tall pine trees.

itinerary.title: Juda Ka Talab to Kedarkantha Base Camp
itinerary.description: Trek through clearing meadows to Kedarkantha Base Camp (11,250ft). Striking sunset views of the snow-clad summit pyramid.

itinerary.title: Kedarkantha Summit (12,500ft) Sunrise & Hargaon
itinerary.description: Early 3:30 AM summit push. Reach summit for glowing Himalayan sunrise over Swargarohini & Bandarpoonch. Descend to Hargaon camp.

itinerary.title: Hargaon to Sankri Village Descent
itinerary.description: Descend through apple orchards and pine groves back to Sankri base village. Rest and celebrate summit success.

itinerary.title: Sankri to Mori White River Campsite
itinerary.description: Drive along the picturesque Tons Valley to Mori riverside camps. Enjoy evening campfire along the roaring mountain river.

itinerary.title: Adventure Activities & Forest Trail at Tons River
itinerary.description: Enjoy river crossing, valley nature trail, pine cone craft workshops, and riverside outdoor relaxation.

itinerary.title: Scenic Drive to Mussoorie / Dehradun
itinerary.description: Scenic drive stopping at Kempty Falls in Mussoorie. Check-in at Dehradun hotel for evening leisure.

itinerary.title: Dehradun Sightseeing & Departure
itinerary.description: Visit Robber’s Cave and Tapkeshwar Temple before departing from Dehradun Railway Station or Jolly Grant Airport.

title: Chopta – Rishikesh Adventure
description: The ultimate blend of high-altitude Himalayan trekking and roaring river adrenaline. Trek to Tungnath (world’s highest Shiva temple) and Chandrashila Summit (13,100ft), followed by world-class rafting and bungee jumping in Rishikesh.
highlights: Tungnath Temple (12,073ft) — world’s highest Shiva shrine
Chandrashila Summit (13,100ft) with Chaukhamba panorama
Deoriatal reflection of snow peaks in crystal clear waters
24km Class III/IV Ganges white water rafting expedition
India’s premier 83m bungee jump & giant canyon swing

itinerary.title: Haridwar/Rishikesh Arrival & Camp Check-in
itinerary.description: Assemble at Rishikesh / Haridwar, transfer to riverside adventure camp in Shivpuri. Welcome drink & evening campfire.

itinerary.title: Rishikesh White Water Rafting & Cliff Jumping
itinerary.description: Hit the rapids from Marine Drive to NIM Beach (16km). Enjoy cliff jumping into the pristine waters of the Ganga.

itinerary.title: Rishikesh to Sari Village & Deoriatal Trek
itinerary.description: Drive along Alaknanda River to Sari village. Trek 2.5km to Deoriatal Lake with breathtaking reflections of Mt. Chaukhamba.

itinerary.title: Deoriatal to Chopta Base Camp Meadows
itinerary.description: Trek / transfer across the scenic rhododendron ridges to Chopta (8,790ft), known as the Mini Switzerland of Uttarakhand.

itinerary.title: Tungnath Temple & Chandrashila Summit (13,100ft)
itinerary.description: Early trek to ancient Tungnath temple and continue to Chandrashila summit for an astonishing 360° panorama of Garhwal Himalayas.

itinerary.title: Chopta to Kund / Rudraprayag Scenic Valley
itinerary.description: Descend to Mandakini Valley. Visit ancient temples and relax in scenic riverside eco-resorts.

itinerary.title: Drive to Rishikesh via Ganga Valleys
itinerary.description: Scenic return drive along the holy rivers. Check-in to luxury riverside resort. Evening visit to Beatles Ashram.

itinerary.title: Bungee Jump, Giant Swing & Triveni Ghat Aarti
itinerary.description: Experience adrenaline rush at Mohan Chatti (Bungee Jump / Flying Fox). Evening soul-stirring Ganga Aarti at Triveni Ghat.

itinerary.title: Morning Yoga & Departure
itinerary.description: Early morning riverside meditation and yoga session, wholesome breakfast, and transfer for onward journey.

title: Manali – Kasol Backpacking Trail
description: The ultimate Himachal backpacking journey through the hippie cafes of Old Manali, the bohemian vibes of Parvati Valley, the natural hot sulfur springs of Kheerganga, and the mystic apple orchards of Tosh.
highlights: Kheerganga summit trek & natural hot water sulfur spring bath
Parvati Valley cafe hopping, Israeli food & live music
Fairy-tale mountain hamlets of Tosh, Chalal & Malana view
Drive through Atal Tunnel into scenic Lahaul Sissu waterfalls
Hadimba temple forest & Old Manali bohemian alleys

itinerary.title: Delhi to Manali Overnight Journey / Arrival
itinerary.description: Overnight journey into the Beas Valley. Arrive in Manali, check-in to riverside backpacker lodge and unwind.

itinerary.title: Manali Local & Old Manali Cafe Hopping
itinerary.description: Explore Hadimba Temple, Manu Temple, Van Vihar, and stroll through the quirky wooden cafes of Old Manali.

itinerary.title: Solang Valley & Atal Tunnel Excursion
itinerary.description: Drive through the Atal Tunnel to Sissu waterfall in Lahaul Valley. Afternoon adventure sports at Solang Valley.

itinerary.title: Jogini Waterfall Hike & Vashisht Hot Springs
itinerary.description: Trek through pine woods to Jogini Waterfalls. Visit ancient Vashisht village for natural thermal sulfur baths.

itinerary.title: Manali to Kasol Parvati Valley Transfer
itinerary.description: Scenic drive into the mystic Parvati Valley. Check into Kasol riverside stay. Stroll around Kasol market and riverside cafes.

itinerary.title: Kasol to Tosh Village & Waterfall Trek
itinerary.description: Drive to Barshaini and trek up to the cliffside village of Tosh (7,874ft). Experience panoramic views of Tosh glacier peaks.

itinerary.title: Kasol to Chalal Nature Walk & Cafe Culture
itinerary.description: Cross the iconic Kasol suspension bridge for a peaceful walk along the Parvati River to Chalal village. Evening acoustic jamming.

itinerary.title: Kheerganga Trek & Natural Hot Spring Bath
itinerary.description: 12km trek through roaring waterfalls and dense oak forests to Kheerganga (9,711ft). Soak in the rejuvenating natural hot springs.

itinerary.title: Kheerganga to Kasol Descent & Manikaran Sahib
itinerary.description: Descend to Barshaini and visit the historic Gurudwara Shri Manikaran Sahib hot springs. Return to Kasol for farewell party.

itinerary.title: Kasol to Delhi / Chandigarh Departure
itinerary.description: Leisurely cafe breakfast, souvenir shopping for local handicrafts, and evening boarding for onward journey.

title: Jaisalmer Desert Adventure Camp
description: An exhilarating desert safari across the golden sand dunes of the Thar. Enjoy dune bashing in 4x4 open jeeps, sunset camel safaris, starlit luxury desert camping, quad biking, and authentic Rajasthani cultural folk evenings.
highlights: Sunset camel safari & deep dune bashing in 4x4 open jeeps
