Luxury Swiss desert tents in Sam Sand Dunes with private washrooms
Nightly Rajasthani Kalbeliya dance, folk songs & campfire dinner
Guided tour of living Golden Fort (Sonar Qila) & Patwon Ki Haveli
Ghost village exploration at abandoned Kuldhara heritage site

itinerary.title: Jaisalmer Golden City Arrival & Fort Tour
itinerary.description: Arrive in Jaisalmer, check into heritage city hotel. Explore the UNESCO living Golden Fort (Sonar Qila) and Gadisar Lake.

itinerary.title: Patwon Ki Haveli & Drive to Sam Sand Dunes Camp
itinerary.description: Visit intricately carved Patwon Ki Haveli, Salim Singh Haveli, and the haunted village of Kuldhara. Drive to Sam Sand Dunes camp. Sunset camel ride.

itinerary.title: Thar Desert Dune Bashing, Quad Biking & Folk Night
itinerary.description: Thrilling 4x4 open jeep safari across undulating sand dunes. Optional quad biking. Evening vibrant Kalbeliya folk music, fire dance & gala dinner.

itinerary.title: Morning Desert Sunrise Walk & Departure
itinerary.description: Experience golden desert sunrise over sand ripples, traditional Rajasthani breakfast, and transfer to Jaisalmer station/airport.

title: Saputara Weekend Hill & Forest Adventure
description: A refreshing weekend escape to Gujarat’s only hill station nestled in the Sahyadri ranges. Experience misty viewpoints, roaring waterfalls, adventure ropeways, governor hill trekking, and tranquil lake boating.
highlights: Breathtaking Gira Waterfalls in full monsoon flow
Governor Hill trek offering panoramic Sahyadri valley views
Saputara Lake boating & sunset point cable car ropeway
Tribal museum and Dang forest biodiversity walk
Adventure sports zone: zip-lining, wall climbing & zorbing

itinerary.title: Arrival in Saputara, Sunset Point & Lake Boating
itinerary.description: Arrive in Saputara hill station. Check into resort. Enjoy paddle boating on Saputara Lake and cable car ride to Sunset Point.

itinerary.title: Gira Waterfalls, Governor Hill Trek & Ropeway
itinerary.description: Morning excursion to the spectacular Gira Waterfalls in Dang forests. Afternoon trek to Governor Hill and adventure activity zone.

itinerary.title: Sunrise Point, Step Garden & Return Departure
itinerary.description: Sunrise view from Sunrise Point / Table Land, visit Step Garden and Tribal Museum before departure with refreshing memories.

title: Beyt Dwarka Marine & Island Camp
description: An extraordinary coastal marine adventure on the Gulf of Kutch. Walk across live coral reefs during low tide, spot wild dolphins leaping in open seas, camp on isolated golden beach shores, and explore underwater marine biodiversity.
highlights: Live coral reef walk observing sea anemones, octopus & corals
Open-sea boat safari with wild dolphin sightings
Island beach camping at secluded Dunny Point
Stargazing and campfire night along the Arabian Sea coast
Visit to ancient Beyt Dwarkadhish temple and Sudama Bridge

itinerary.title: Arrival at Okha & Boat to Beyt Dwarka Island Camp
itinerary.description: Assemble at Okha / Dwarka. Take a scenic ferry ride across the Gulf to Beyt Dwarka island. Check into beach tents. Sunset beach games and campfire.

itinerary.title: Marine Life Exploration, Coral Walk & Snorkeling
itinerary.description: Low-tide guided coral walk at Dunny Point. Observe vibrant live corals, sea sponges, starfish, and pufferfish. Evening dolphin spotting session.

itinerary.title: Dolphin Safari, Dwarkadhish Temple & Departure
itinerary.description: Early morning dolphin spotting boat cruise. Visit sacred Beyt Dwarkadhish Temple and Sudama Setu before return transfer.

title: Dalhousie Adventure Camp
description: Nature and adventure camp in serene Dalhousie. Trek across Khajjiar pine meadows, hike to Dainkund peak, explore Chamba valley, and enjoy evening campfire circles in the cool Himalayan air.
highlights: Khajjiar mini-Switzerland green alpine meadow
Dainkund peak panoramic view of Himalayan Pir Panjal range
Nature study trails and bird watching amidst deodar forests
Campfire games, star gazing, and group bonding

itinerary.title: Arrival in Dalhousie & Camp Briefing
itinerary.description: Arrive at Dalhousie camp. Orientation, tent allotment, acclimatization walk through pine forests, and evening campfire.

itinerary.title: Khajjiar Meadow & Dainkund Summit Hike
itinerary.description: Full day excursion to Khajjiar lake and meadow. Hike to Dainkund Peak for 360-degree views of snowy Himalayan ranges.

itinerary.title: Nature Trail & Departure
itinerary.description: Morning nature walk, breakfast, certificates of participation, and departure.

title: Mussoorie Adventure Camp
description: Adventure activities and rock craft amid the rolling green hills of Mussoorie. Experience natural cliff rappelling, rock climbing, pine forest trekking, and scenic ridge camping overlooking Garhwal Himalayas.
highlights: Natural rock climbing and rappelling training with certified instructors
Kempty Falls and river stream crossing
Ridge camping with misty Garhwal mountain sunsets
Team building adventure games and night campfire

itinerary.title: Arrival at Mussoorie Camp & Ice Breaking
itinerary.description: Assemble at Mussoorie camp base. Safety briefing, tent pitching demonstration, and evening campfire.

itinerary.title: Rock Climbing, Rappelling & Stream Crossing
itinerary.description: Full day technical adventure training on natural rock faces. Afternoon hike to scenic viewpoints.

itinerary.title: Morning Ridge Walk & Return Departure
itinerary.description: Early morning sunrise walk along the ridge, breakfast, certificate distribution, and departure.

title: Manali Adventure Camp
description: Comprehensive mountain adventure camp in Manali featuring Beas river crossing, rock craft, snow craft, paragliding, deodar forest trails, and alpine camping under snowy Pir Panjal peaks.
highlights: Beas River rock craft and Tyrolean traverse
Solang Valley adventure activities and trekking
Hadimba deodar forest wilderness walk
Campfire nights with snow peaks panorama

itinerary.title: Arrival at Manali Camp & River Orientation
itinerary.description: Check into riverside alpine camp. Orientation, equipment check, and gentle acclimatization hike.

itinerary.title: Rock Craft, River Crossing & Solang Valley
itinerary.description: Hands-on rock climbing, rappelling, and Tyrolean traverse across the mountain stream. Afternoon in Solang Valley.

itinerary.title: Deodar Trail Trek & Departure
itinerary.description: Morning guided hike through old Manali pine forests, farewell brunch, and departure transfers.

title: Gir Nature Education & Family Camp
description: An enriching wildlife and nature education camp in the heart of Sasan Gir — the last global sanctuary of the Asiatic Lion. Designed for children, parents, and families with wildlife safaris, bird-watching, wilderness workshops, and recognized participation certificates.
highlights: Open Gypsy Safari inside Gir National Park to spot Asiatic Lions
Official Nature Education & Wildlife Camp Participation Certificate
Interactive nature workshops, pugmark casting & bird watching
Stay in eco-friendly nature camp resort with swimming pool & lawns
Cultural Siddi Dhamal tribal dance & campfire evening

itinerary.title: Arrival at Gir National Park & Orientation
itinerary.description: Arrive at Sasan Gir eco-resort. Check-in and welcome drink. Afternoon orientation, nature education audio-visual briefing, and interactive bird-watching trail.

itinerary.title: Open Gypsy Lion Safari & Nature Workshop
itinerary.description: Early morning open Gypsy Safari in Gir National Park deep jungle zones to spot Asiatic lions, leopards, and spotted deer. Afternoon pugmark casting workshop and evening Siddi tribal dance around campfire.

itinerary.title: Nature Trail Walk, Certificate Ceremony & Departure
itinerary.description: Early morning guided botanical and butterfly walk along Hiran River. Official Nature Education Certificate distribution ceremony and farewell lunch before departure.

title: Gir Family Camping & Safari
description: A cozy overnight wilderness getaway for families and nature enthusiasts. Enjoy mango orchard camping, Devalia Safari Park excursion, evening stargazing, and delicious organic farm food.
highlights: Devalia Safari Park lion & wildlife sighting guaranteed
Camping in scenic Kesar mango orchard tents
Authentic wood-fired Kathiyawadi dinner with Bajra Rotla & Ringna No Olo
Night stargazing session and campfire family games
Crocodile breeding center & Hiran river nature trail
